title: Software/AI Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Software/AI Engineer  
**Location:** Egypt (Seero Engineering Consulting Office)  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

**About Seero Engineering Consulting**  
Seero is a leading multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, delivering innovative solutions across buildings, infrastructure, and industrial projects. We are committed to integrating advanced digital technologies, artificial intelligence, and software solutions to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and value in engineering and project delivery.

**Position Overview**  
We are seeking a talented **Software/AI Engineer** to join our Egypt office. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing software tools and AI\-driven solutions to support engineering workflows, data analysis, and digital transformation initiatives across Seero’s projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and software applications for engineering and project management.
* Automate processes related to BIM, project planning, resource management, and data analysis.
* Integrate AI solutions into existing systems, improving efficiency and decision\-making.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (BIM, engineering, IT) to develop customized digital tools.
* Conduct research on emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applications in engineering consultancy.
* Develop APIs, dashboards, and data visualization tools for project monitoring.
* Ensure scalability, performance, and security of developed solutions.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in software development and AI/ML model deployment.
* Strong programming skills (Python, C\#, Java, or similar).
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
* Knowledge of BIM\-related software integration (Revit API, Dynamo, etc.) is a strong plus.
* Proficiency in database management and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

**Why Join Seero?**

* Opportunity to drive digital transformation in a leading engineering consultancy.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI and software applications in real\-world projects.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Job Type: Full\-time

title: AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer**

 **Purpose of the Job**

This role is pivotal in our commitment to leveraging cutting\-edge artificial intelligence to advance our mission. This person will be a hands\-on professional with a passion for experimenting with emerging AI assistants, large language models (LLMs), and other AI technologies. This role will be responsible for identifying, testing, and integrating these tools into our existing technological infrastructure to enhance our programs, fundraising, streamline operations, and drive data\-informed decision\-making.

 **Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* Analyze business processes using the workflow process management function and partner with Data Analysts to evaluate data flows, then proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI solutions that optimize efficiency, automate tasks, and support informed decision\-making.
* Research, experiment with, and evaluate emerging AI assistants, generative AI tools, and large language models (LLMs) to determine high\-value use cases aligned with organizational goals.
* Design and develop AI prototypes and proof\-of\-concept integrations to demonstrate how AI tools can be effectively integrated into internal systems to enhance efficiency, automation, and operational workflows.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to identify practical challenges and opportunities where AI can be applied to simplify work, save time, or improve outcomes.
* Build, fine\-tune, and deploy ML models tailored to nonprofit\-specific use cases such as donor insights, operational automation, and content generation.
* Use advanced Python skills and ML tools to develop and fine\-tune AI models for practical applications.
* Implement AI solutions in compliance with ethical standards, including bias mitigation, data privacy, and fairness, and contribute to shaping the organization's AI governance framework.
* Train non\-technical staff on basic AI concepts, opportunities, and risks.

Design and implement AI architecture, model integration strategies, and data pipelines to enable seamless deployment into existing systems.  
* 

  

**Required Education, Experience, Knowledge and Skills**

* Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, or a relevant field.
* 1 to 3 of hands\-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience working within project teams, supporting the implementation of AI solutions in coordination with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Proficiency in Python and core ML frameworks.
* Practical experience with AI/LLM deployment, including Chabot's, assistants, or generative AI.
* Good understanding of data ethics, bias, and responsible AI principles.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills.
* Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and their integration with data and AI workflows.
* Ability to gather, analyze and present information and numerical data effectively, and a demonstrated, high level of accuracy and thoroughness in all duties.

 **Travel and Working Requirements**

* Limited to typical office environment such as walking, sitting, typing, using office equipment, and occasional lifting of boxes or luggage during travel.
* Occasional travel, nationally or internationally, is expected.
* Working out of the official hours and on weekends may be required.

description:
**Job Description**
 Deriv is an AI\-first company, transforming trading through cutting\-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled Applied AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying AI\-driven solutions that power our internal tools, marketing automation, and security infrastructure.
   

  

 AI is being embedded into our company DNA, across every department. For further information, please read our guide: ‘AI at Deriv:How we’re transforming fintech with AI’ .
   

  

**Your Challenges**
 AI Solution Development
   

  

* Design, build, and operate agentic LLM applications with tool\-use/function calling, planning, memory, and structured outputs with versioned prompts.
* Implement RAG pipelines (hybrid dense\+sparse retrieval, reranking); manage vector indices and the embedding lifecycle.
* Integrate models with internal services and third\-party APIs via tool adapters; enforce schema contracts and access controls.
* Lead feature work in recommendation/ranking, content generation/editing, and workflow orchestration backed by measurable eval metrics.


 Security \& Automation
   

  

* Build AI\-driven security automations: classifiers/anomaly detectors, red\-teaming harnesses, and (where appropriate) autonomous testing agents.
* Implement safety \& privacy controls: prompt\-injection/jailbreak defenses, PII redaction, policy filtering, and auditability.
* Stand up real\-time tracing \& alerts on token/latency/cost, retrieval degradation, drift, and hallucination risk.


 Project \& Task Management
   

  

* Own model/prompt/agent versioning and ship via CI/CD with canaries/A\-B, rollback plans, and clear SLOs (quality, latency, cost).
* Evolve workflows: PR\-based changes to prompts/configs, experiment tracking, concise design docs, and ADRs (decision records).


 Quality Assurance \& Code Review
   

  

* Enforce evaluation\-first development: golden sets, synthetic probes, regression tests for prompts, grounding/faithfulness checks.
* Review for determinism, observability, and reproducibility; address tech debt with a bias to stability and measured impact.


 Collaboration \& Mentorship
   

  

* Partner with platform/data teams on data contracts, retrieval standards, and tenancy/access control.
* Mentor peers on agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, and safe rollout; lead design reviews and share practical research findings.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Benchmark and integrate new model families/tools via standardized bake\-offs; report quality–latency–cost trade\-offs.
* Optimize serving with adapters/LoRA, distillation/quantization, routing/caching/speculative decoding; right\-size infra for cost/perf.
* Track industry and research trends; convert into pragmatic, incremental stack upgrades.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Solid understanding of security best practices and experience with security automation is a plus.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience with task management and code collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, ClickUp, etc.).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a fast\-paced, collaborative team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in AI/ML engineering, with a proven track record of delivering production\-grade solutions.
* Experience with marketing automation, content generation, or design systems.
* Familiarity with Figma, Supabase, or similar platforms.
* Contributions to open source AI/security projects.
* Prior experience in a high\-growth tech or fintech environment.


**Benefits**
 We pay competitive salaries based on your skills, qualifications, experience and market rates. Additionally, you’ll be eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.
   

  

 When you join Deriv, you will be supported in growing your career in our company. You can expect to have a personalised Learning and Development programme as well as the costs covered for relevant professional development and education related to advancing your career at Deriv.
   

  

 You’ll be based at our modern office in Dubai’s prestigious Business Bay, a key centre for Deriv’s Middle Eastern operations. Our Dubai office is home to over 200 talented professionals from diverse nationalities, creating a truly global workplace. You’ll thrive in an expat\-friendly environment that celebrates diversity and encourages cross\-cultural collaboration, with regular knowledge\-sharing sessions and team events.
   

  

 Dubai’s position as a global business hub, combined with its tax\-free benefits, ultramodern lifestyle, and family\-friendly environment with excellent schools and healthcare, creates the perfect setting for international professionals. Join us in Dubai to shape the future of online trading while experiencing life in one of the world’s most dynamic and cosmopolitan cities.

**Für den Ausbau unseres cross\-funktionalen Teams in München suchen wir ab sofort eine:n**
****Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d)****
**Pioniergeist gesucht!** 
 Werde Teil unseres News\-Publishing Unternehmens und trage dazu bei, den Digitaljournalismus im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz für Redaktionen weiterzuentwickeln. Wir suchen eine:n engagierte:n AI Engineer, der/die unser interdisziplinäres Team verstärkt und den Aufbau und die Entwicklung journalistischer Produkte auf der Basis von generativen KI\-Modellen vorantreibt. Wenn du den Herausforderungen der Zukunft gewachsen bist und eine Leidenschaft für AI und LLMs hast, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
   

  

**Was Dich Erwartet**
* Du bist maßgeblich daran beteiligt, innovative AI\-Lösungen unter Einsatz von Large Language Models (LLMs) und Voice to Action zu konzipieren und umzusetzen
* Du spielst eine Schlüsselrolle bei der strategischen Weichenstellung für den Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte, um eine effiziente Nutzung von LLMs in journalistischen Anwendungen zu gewährleisten
* Du entwickelst innovative MVPs für unsere AI Services gemeinsam in einem crossfunktionalen Team bestehend aus AI\-, Frontend\- und Backend\-Engineers, sowie Agentic UX Designern
* Du hältst dich stets auf dem neuesten Stand der Technologieentwicklung im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz und Cloud\-Infrastrukturen. Du bewertest neue Technologien, Tools und Frameworks und bringst dein Fachwissen in die Entscheidungsfindung für die Auswahl der optimalen Lösungen ein


****Was wir dir bieten:****
* Eine gemeinsame wertvolle Vision: den lokalen Journalismus weiterhin pluralistisch und unabhängig zu gestalten und damit die Meinungsvielfalt in der Gesellschaft zu fördern
* Es warten auf dich spannende und verantwortungsvolle Herausforderungen im Digitaljournalismus in einem dynamisch wachsenden Medienhaus im Herzen von München, wo du interdisziplinär arbeiten und top\-aktuelles Wissen im Bereich Online\-Medien sammeln kannst
* Wir bieten dir ein angenehmes Betriebsklima mit agilen, kreativen und motivierten Kollegen, bei denen der wertschätzende Umgang einen hohen Stellenwert genießt
* Ein umfassendes Onboarding mit Durchlauf aller relevanter Stationen und jede Menge Weiterbildung und Coaching, z.B. durch unsere ID Academy
* Good to know: Flache Hierarchien in einer transparenten und agilen Unternehmenskultur, 30 Tage Urlaub, freie Systemauswahl, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Sabbaticals, Working abroad, Mitarbeiterrabatte (corporate benefits), Bikeleasing, Zuschüsse für die Inhouse\-Kantine, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Firmenevents


****Was du mitbringst:****
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Machine Learning oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
* Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von AI\-gestützten Lösungen, insbesondere unter der Verwendung von Large Language Models, Voice to Action, sowie Agentic User Interfaces
* Programmierkenntnisse in Java, Python und Erfahrung mit relevanten Frameworks wie LangChain
* Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Infrastrukturen, idealerweise mit AWS oder Google Cloud
* Gute Kenntnisse in der Cloud Native Softwareentwicklung, z.B. Docker, Kubernetes
* Erfahrung mit CI/CD\-Prozessen und Automatisierungstools wie GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins o.ä.
* Kreativität, Neugierde und Innovationsgeist, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren
* Teamplayer\-Mentalität und die Fähigkeit, in einem interdisziplinären Team zu arbeiten
* Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch


**Bist du bereit, den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere als AI Engineer (m/w/d) zu machen?** 
 Bewirb dich einfach online bei uns. Schick uns deinen CV als PDF oder melde dich bei deinem persönlichen Ansprechpartner. Für uns ist es entscheidend, mehr über dich und deinen Lebenslauf zu erfahren.
   

  

**Dein Ansprechpartner: Christian Celikovic**
 Dir ist noch etwas unklar? Deinen Ansprechpartner Christian Celikovic erreichst du einfach per E\-Mail christian.celikovic@ippen\-digital.de oder unter \+49 89 541 984 07\.
   

  

**Über Ippen Digital**
 Für über 80 Portale entwickelt Ippen Digital digitale Publishing\-Produkte. Ob regionaler Verlag oder Special\-Interest\-Themen – wir haben eine Lösung für ihren Online\-Auftritt. Damit sind wir die führende Plattform und bieten dazu Technik, Redaktion und Sales aus einer Hand. Unser Erfolgsgeheimnis: Neue Ideen, ungewöhnliche Denkansätze und ständiger Austausch.

title: AI Engineer (all genders)
description:
#### **Über uns**

*Du hast Lust, die Zukunft der medizinischen Versorgung mitzugestalten und KI\-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Diagnostik, Therapie und Prävention revolutionieren?*

*Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!*


LillianCare ist ein führendes Gesundheitsunternehmen, das innovative medizinische Lösungen durch die Kombination von traditioneller Hausarztmedizin und modernster Telemedizin bietet. Unsere Mission ist es, die medizinische Versorgung in ländlichen und unterversorgten Gebieten zu revolutionieren und zugänglich zu machen. Mit einem wachsenden Netzwerk von Partnerpraxen und einem engagierten Team von Fachärzten, PAs und MFAs streben wir danach, die Gesundheitslandschaft zu transformieren, indem wir qualitativ hochwertige Versorgung anbieten, die sowohl flexibel als auch integrativ ist.


 Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir als Verstärkung für unser **I****T\-Team** einen


AI Engineer (all genders)
zur Vollzeitanstellung.

#### **Aufgaben**

* Du entwickelst und verfeinerst unsere AI\-Strategie mit einem klaren Fokus auf Diagnostik\-, Therapie\- und Vorhersagemodelle.
* Große Mengen an Patientendaten aus PVS\-Systemen, Freitexten, Fragebögen, Laborwerten und Medikationsplänen bereitest Du so auf, dass sie sinnvoll integriert und genutzt werden können.
* Mit Machine Learning und LLMs baust Du Modelle, die patientenspezifische Vorhersagen ermöglichen – von Krankheitsrisiken über Therapievorschläge bis hin zum Versorgungsbedarf.
* Du entwickelst eine Wissensdatenbank, die medizinische Leitlinien, Fachliteratur und interne Datenquellen bündelt und für KI\-Modelle nutzbar macht.
* Gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam bringst Du intelligente KI\-Funktionalitäten direkt in die Patienten\- und Praxis\-App, damit unsere Nutzer von smarten Vorschlägen und Entscheidungsunterstützung profitieren.
* Du achtest darauf, dass Datenschutz, Anonymisierung und regulatorische Vorgaben wie DSGVO, KBV/Gematik oder MDR jederzeit eingehalten werden.
* Du entwickelst Prototypen und Proof\-of\-Concepts, testest neue Technologien und bewertest deren Praxistauglichkeit.
* Die Performance Deiner Modelle behältst Du stets im Blick und bewertest sie anhand von Bias, Fairness, Genauigkeit und klinischer Relevanz.
* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Ärzten, MFAs und medizinischen Beratern stellst Du sicher, dass die entwickelten Lösungen auch im Praxisalltag funktionieren.
* Gemeinsam mit dem Team baust Du eine skalierbare AI\-Infrastruktur auf, die sowohl in der Cloud als auch On\-Premise betrieben werden kann.

#### **Was Du mitbringst**

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet – oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch praktische Erfahrung.
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, Deep Learning und Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Verarbeitung und Integration heterogener Datenquellen, idealerweise aus dem Gesundheitswesen, und beherrschst Datenaufbereitung, Feature Engineering und Modelltraining.
* Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Cloud\-Plattformen wie AWS, Google, Azure oder NVIDIA und hast Erfahrungen mit deren AI\-Tools.
* Du kennst die relevanten Datenschutzbestimmungen (z. B. DSGVO, Medizinprodukteverordnung) und setzt diese in der Entwicklung verantwortungsvoller KI\-Lösungen um.
* Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär und bringst Deine Expertise in die Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, MFAs und Produktteams ein, um klinische Relevanz sicherzustellen.
* Du bist kommunikativ, lösungsorientiert und bringst eine hohe Eigenmotivation sowie die Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung mit.
* Sichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1\) runden Dein Profil ab.

#### **Das erwartet Dich bei uns**

* Mit einem **attraktiven Fixgehalt** wird Deine Leistung angemessen honoriert, sodass Engagement direkt sichtbar belohnt wird.
* **30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr** geben Dir ausreichend Zeit, um eine ausgewogene Work\-Life\-Balance zu genießen.
* Eine super flexible **Homeoffice\-Regelung** erlaubt es Dir, Arbeit und Privatleben optimal zu kombinieren.
* Wenn Du nicht vor Ort bist, kannst Du zwischen Homeoffice oder unserem Büro in Mannheim wählen.
* Spannende Teamevents sorgen für jede Menge Spaß und bringen das Team richtig zusammen.
* Ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team sowie ein professionelles Praxisteam an unseren Standorten, das dich unterstützt und willkommen heißt.
* Die Chance, im Jahr 2026 aktiv am dynamischen Wachstum unseres Unternehmens mitzuwirken und beruflich sowie persönlich zu wachsen – mit echtem Purpose.

#### **Interessiert?**


Möchtest Du die Zukunft der hausärztlichen Versorgung aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bewirb Dich direkt über den Button!

 **Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!**

* Zur besseren Lesbarkeit verwenden wir in unseren Texten teilweise das generische Maskulinum. Selbstverständlich sind dabei stets alle Geschlechter gleichermaßen gemeint. Die gewählte Form dient ausschließlich der sprachlichen Vereinfachung und beinhaltet keinerlei Wertung.

#### **Über uns**


LillianCare widmet sich der Herausforderung des Ärztemangels in Deutschland durch die Einrichtung hybrider Praxen landesweit, um überall qualitativ hochwertige Versorgung zu sichern. Wir setzen auf innovative Technologien, Teamarbeit und flexible Arbeitsmodelle, um exzellente Patientenbetreuung zu gewährleisten.  

  

Mit LillianCare kannst Du einen echten Unterschied machen und aktiv zur Bekämpfung des Ärztemangels in ländlichen Gebieten beitragen. Dieses bewährte Modell, das in anderen Ländern bereits erfolgreich umgesetzt wurde, bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, Deine Fähigkeiten optimal einzusetzen.

 **Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d)** 
 , um den genAI\-Bereich bei AOE weiter mit auszubauen! Mit deiner Expertise trägst du dazu bei, innovative Kundenlösungen zu entwickeln, AI\-Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen und unsere AI\-Expertise gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

 – Du kennst dich mit Technologien wie Lucene, GraphDB oder Vector DB aus und weißt, wie sie effizient eingesetzt werden

 – Du verstehst ML, Deep Learning, NLP und hast fundierte Kenntnisse über LLMs und deren Integration

title: Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Aus 1 mach 91\.000 – so beginnt unsere Unternehmensgeschichte. Und sie ist noch lange nicht zu Ende erzählt:
   

  

 Inhabergeführt, in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten kontinuierlich gewachsen und heute einer der größten unabhängigen IT\- und Businessdienstleister der Welt. Durch unsere Kundennähe entstehen vertrauensvolle Beziehungen und unsere Branchen\- und Technologiekompetenz ermöglicht es, die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen zu erfüllen.
   

  

 Im Bereich Transport \& Logistik – insbesondere im Bereich Aviation und Retail – entwickeln wir für unsere Kunden innovative Lösungen, um den digitalen Wandel aktiv mitzugestalten. Künstliche Intelligenz spielt dabei eine immer zentralere Rolle: von intelligenten Systemen im Betrieb über optimierte Entscheidungsunterstützung bis hin zu innovativen Anwendungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
   

  

 Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d).
   

  

 Aufgaben
   

  

 In deiner Rolle als Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d) arbeitest du zusammen mit unseren Kunden an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung moderner, AI\-gestützter Lösungen. Dabei übernimmst du unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:
   

  

* Du leitest technische AI\-Projekte und entwickelst AI\-Lösungen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Modellauswahl bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
* Du gestaltest verantwortungsvollen und gesetzeskonformen AI\-Einsatz und bringst dich aktiv in AI\-Governance\-Themen und ethische Fragestellungen ein.
* Du begleitest Kunden beim Aufbau von AI\-Infrastrukturen und unterstützt bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Systeme.
* Du berätst bei Change\- und Prozessmanagement\-Themen und unterstützt bei der strukturierten Einführung von AI\-Technologien.
* Du arbeitest eng mit interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und gestaltest den Wandel zu AI\-getriebenen Betriebsmodellen aktiv mit.


 Qualifikation
   

  

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Fundierte Erfahrung mit modernen AI\-Tools und Technologien (z.B. LLMs, Python, OpenAI)
* Branchenkenntnisse in Retail, Aviation oder Transport/Logistik sind wünschenswert
* Kommunikationsstärke, konzeptionelles Denken und ein sicheres Auftreten im Kundenkontakt
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse


**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten!
   

  

 Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.
   

  

 Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen\- und Technologie\-Kompetenz zu profitieren.
   

  

 Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

title: AWS AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
**Unternehmensbeschreibung**

 **curious about how AI features become products** 
 . If you’re excited by the idea of influencing roadmaps, shaping requirements, or owning end\-to\-end value delivery — we’ll give you space to grow into it. This is a role where engineering and product
 **are not silos** 
 . If you’re keen to move in that direction, we’ll mentor and support your evolution.
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Salary Range: Competitive, adjusted for experience and location.
* Benefits: Comprehensive global and local packages, including wellness and training support.

 You’ll be part of a team that’s pushing AI/ML into uncharted, high\-value territory. We operate with urgency, autonomy, and deep collaboration. You’ll prototype fast, deliver often, and see your work shape real\-world outcomes — whether in underwriting, claims, or data orchestration. And if you're looking to
 **transition from deep tech to product leadership** 
 , this role is a launchpad.
   

  

**Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer** 
 . We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
### **The Role**


We are currently seeking a talented and autonomous **Forward Deployed AI Engineer** to join our optimAI team, reporting to VP Innovation and AI Services. This is a crucial, high\-impact role for a self\-starter who will be responsible for bringing our most innovative AI concepts to life, from initial prototype to final deployment. The most important skill is a deep curiosity and a scientific mindset, alongside a desire to build incredible things. You will be a hands\-on generalist, bridging the gap between data science, software engineering, and generative AI. Your primary goal is to work to outcomes, not specific instructions, with a focus on delivering tangible value that delights the customer. The role may require time spent on\-site with customers to deliver solutions.


We love to work with people who have a deeply curious mindset and the ability to work in an agile, fast\-paced environment. You will monitor technology trends, build solutions, and have the opportunity to experiment and define the future. You must be able to articulate the "why" behind your work in terms of clear customer value, and we want you to develop your opinions and deep insights for the projects you work on.


Successful candidates must be eligible for, and able to obtain and maintain, Security Check (SC) level security clearance.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Development:** Design, build, and deploy AI\-driven solutions, including setting up databases, creating data pipelines, and integrating models into production systems.
* **AI and Machine Learning:** Track the latest model releases, compare and evaluate them against customer use\-cases, explore and deploy the latest AI data architectures.
* **Infrastructure Management:** Configure and manage local AI infrastructure, including setting up and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs) and knowledge bases for local use.
* **Full\-Stack Development with AI integration:** Create front\-end prototypes and back\-end systems for agentic simulations and other AI applications to showcase their potential. Be comfortable working with both manual\- and AI\-generated code.
* **Prompt and Query Engineering:** Work alongside our data scientists to develop and test complex queries and prompt engineering techniques to optimize the performance of our AI models.
* **Research and Learning:** Capture key learnings, pitfalls, and best practices from your work to inform our overall AI strategy and future roadmap.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data scientists, and senior leadership, to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* **Project Ownership:** Autonomously drive projects and be able to clearly articulate the value of each one to the customer. This requires a self\-starter who can work to outcomes rather than just following instructions.
* **Travel and On\-Site Working:** Be willing to spend time deployed with customers to solve their most difficult problems using our software and solutions.

### **Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise**

* **Education:** an undergraduate degree in a technical discipline (computer science, mathematics, physics, etc.) from a top university. Relevant Masters and PhD qualifications will be considered a strong plus.
* **AI/ML Expertise:** Hands\-on experience with a variety of AI tools, frameworks, and concepts, including working with **LLMs (Large Language Models)**, **RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)**, and deploying AI solutions.
* **Software Development:** Ability to think in terms of abstractions, modularity, and repeatability, as well as work with AI code generation agents. Experience with languages like Rust, C\+\+, or Python is a significant plus. Although desirable, there is no explicit requirement for previous\-years\-of\-experience; we’re looking for skills as opposed to time served.
* **Technical Versatility:** A strong background as a generalist engineer with demonstrated experience across multiple technical domains. The ability to write great code is more important than proficiency in any specific language.
* **Execution Focus:** Able to act fast and decisively to get things done, with a bias towards action. You should be systematic but not rigid, making thoughtful tradeoffs to move projects forward.
* **Customer\-Centric Mindset:** An ability to understand customer value hypotheses against concepts and translate them into functional prototypes.
* **Deep Curiosity \& Humility:** A deeply curious mindset is essential. You should also be humble and comfortable saying "I don't know" when appropriate.
* **Communication:** Can articulate complex and highly technical ideas clearly. You should be able to communicate effectively internally and externally.

### **Job Benefits**


We make Hadean an awesome place to work with competitive benefits…

* The option to work from home (Weds/Thurs/Fri) or from our fantastic office in Shoreditch, London (as many days as you like!)
* Flexible working
* Private Health Insurance
* Enhanced pension scheme
* Enhanced parental leave
* 3 extra days off at Christmas (on top of our standard 25\)
* L\&D budget
* Regularly scheduled socials
* Share options

### **A Place For Everyone**


We believe diversity drives innovation and for that reason we strongly encourage those from all backgrounds to apply for roles at Hadean. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to build a workforce that is truly representative of the communities in which we operate and our clients.


If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, please speak with the People team who will be happy to support you. If you have a preferred pronoun, please feel free to highlight this during the process (e.g. she/her, he/him, they/them, etc.).

description:
, United Kingdom

**Job Description:**

**What’s the role**

As the Senior Quant Engineer, you will join the growing Quant Engineering Capability Centre of Shell Energy. This team supports Shell’s SLMT trading business with advanced quant engineering solutions. Shell Energy operates one of the largest energy trading platforms globally, with key hubs in Singapore, Dubai, Houston, London, and Rotterdam, trading in natural gas, LNG, electrical power, and environmental products.


You will collaborate with traders and quantitative analysts to transform their models into software applications that support Shell’s trading decisions, aligned with best\-practice software engineering processes and architectural patterns.


You will develop software applications to transform, scale, and productionise a variety of quantitative and probabilistic financial modelling algorithms. These include computations of risk and return metrics, Black\-Scholes models, and Monte Carlo simulations. You will effectively leverage our Azure platform, our Data Lakehouse architecture and Platform Services to create best in class Trading Applications. You will also have line management responsibilities of a very talented and high performing product development team.


**What you’ll be doing**

The Senior Quant Engineer is responsible for coding and understanding complex mathematical models that support trading decisions. This role supports analysts in deploying their models within the Azure cloud framework. A background in scientific or logical reasoning and an understanding of commodities trading are necessary for effective collaboration with analysts and quantitative researchers. This role needs solid software engineering skills, with experience in Python, C\#, application architecture and design, automation testing, deployment, cloud infrastructure knowledge, source control, CI/CD, and security.


The primary accountabilities of the Senior Quant Engineer are:


* Create enterprise grade applications with Python or .NET like web applications on Azure cloud infrastructure with Docker, Kubernetes, automation testing and DevOps (ideally terraform \+ github actions).
* Create, monitor and maintain data pipelines and batch processes (databricks, pyspark, lakehouses, kafka).
* Productionise quant models into software applications, ensuring robust day\-to\-day operation, monitoring and back testing are in place.
* Stakeholder engagement: Elicit, validate and translate business requirements from traders and analysts into feasible software application features.
* Work closely with analysts and quants to develop models, providing technical support and guidance.
* Produce accurate, performant, scalable, secure software, and support best practices following defined IT standards
* Expand proof of concepts into fully deployable products both within Shell and externally.
* Work in a highly\-collaborative, friendly Agile environment, participate in Agile ceremonies and Continuous Improvement activities.
* Ensure that documentation and explanations of analytical or modelling results are appropriately tailored to meet the needs of both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Mentor and coach other teammates who are upskilling in Quants Engineering.
* Maintain quality by performing routine health checks, audits, and code reviews to ensure project teams produce clean, maintainable code.
* Evaluate and benchmark all new initiatives prior to developing solutions.
* Maintain awareness of emerging engineering methodologies and advancements in artificial intelligence, while continually refining our Agile processes and fostering strong collaborations with academia, IDT, and industry partners.
* Contribute to community building initiatives like Quant Capability Centre for Shell Energy.

**What you bring**

We are committed to attracting a broader and more diverse pool of candidates. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every listed requirement. We value potential, passion and a willingness to learn, and we believe great talent can grow into a role


We are keen to hear from candidates with the following:


* Postgraduation /PhD with substantial years’ work experience as software developer /data scientist/ AI engineer.
* Degree level in STEM, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a relevant field of applied mathematics.
* Good understanding of Trading terminology and concepts (incl. financial derivatives), gained from experience working in a Trading or Finance environment
* Expert in core Python with Python scientific stack / ecosystem (including pandas, numpy, scipy, stats), and a second strongly typed language (e.g.: C\#, C\+\+, Rust or Java)
* Expert in application design, security, release, testing and packaging
* Mastery of SQL / no\-SQL databases, data pipeline orchestration tools
* Mastery of concurrent/distributed programming and performance optimisation methods.
* Experienced in Cloud Technologies – Azure / AWS
* Experienced in Source Control Technologies (including GitHub, Azure DevOps), CI/CD and Test Automation.
* Mathematics skills, experience working with quantitative methods / probabilistic modelling, preferably in the context of financial derivatives valuation
* Familiarity with e.g. PnL, greeks, volatility, partial derivative, normal distribution
* Financial and/or trading exposure particularly energy commodities
* Experienced in business analysis, with the capability to convert requirements from traders or quantitative analysts into software product specifications.
* Able to work in a fast\-paced front office environment and communicate directly with analysts and traders
* Aptitude to provide technical guidance and coaching to users / customers
* Able to analyse and interpret complex information.
* Derivatives experience in LNG, Gas or Power Trading
* Knowledge of Short\-term trading, portfolio trading, physical assets trading (CCGT, Wind, Solar, Battery)
* Risk \- Modelling \& understanding of risk \& risk management
* Commodity Modelling \- Energy (power, gas, environmental products) and meteorology
* Knowledge of Information Management, data strategy and governance
* Commercial skills in Value Assurance, Value estimation and Realization, end\-to\-end value mapping

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.


* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non\-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

*Note:* *As part of your application, please submit a motivation letter along with your resume. The motivation letter should outline your reasons for applying to this position and how your skills and experiences align with the job requirements. This will help us better understand your interest in the role and your suitability for the position.*

**We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,**

**Shell in The United Kingdom**

Shell UK remains one of the North Sea’s biggest producers, supplying around 10% of the UK’s total oil and gas needs. But perhaps the most recognisable face of Shell in the UK is our network of over 1,000 Shell\-branded service stations.


In the years ahead, as the UK looks to strengthen energy security and deliver its 2050 net\-zero goal, Shell UK aims to play a crucial role. We aim to be a major investor in the UK energy system by helping our customers decarbonise with a focus on transport and industry.

**What you'll be doing**


* Model Development: design, train, and evaluate end\-to\-end ML models \- from preprocessing to deployment \- working with text, vision, and tabular data.
* LLM \& AI Systems: build and refine applications leveraging large language models, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks to solve real\-world business problems.

 You'll be working at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI and robust, scalable cloud infrastructure. We are building our next\-generation platform on a modern stack, and your expertise will be crucial in leveraging these tools to their full potential.
 



  





 Our agentic architecture will be built on powerful frameworks like
 **LangChain** 
 and
 **LangGraph** 
 , which we are exploring for their advanced state management and cyclical graph capabilities. We are also evaluating other leading tools like
 **AutoGen** 
 and
 **CrewAI** 
 to orchestrate seamless collaboration and decision\-making between our agents.
 



  





 The core intelligence for our agents will be powered by a diverse range of Large Language Models (LLMs), chosen based on the specific needs of each application. This includes using models like Google's
 **Gemini Models** 
 via
 **Vertex AI** 
 , as well as other leading API\-based models. In addition, you will be responsible for deploying and managing self\-hosted models to meet specific performance, security, and cost requirements. You will be responsible for deploying these services using
 **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)** 
 for our scalable, containerized solutions, and leveraging
 **Cloud Run** 
 and
 **Cloud Functions** 
 for serverless, event\-driven microservices.

 **SingleStore** 
 , our existing high\-performance database, as the central hub for both our relational and vector data, eliminating the need to manage a separate vector database. You will use its native vector search capabilities to build and optimize our
 **RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)** 
 pipelines. For unstructured data and large artifacts, we will rely on
 **GCP Cloud Storage** 
 .

 **Vertex AI** 
 for model management and
 **Google Cloud Logging / Cloud Monitoring** 
 for observability. We also plan to use
 **LangSmith** 
 to monitor, evaluate, and debug our complex agentic workflows, ensuring high performance and reliability.

 **creative builder and a technical leader** 
 , excited by the chance to develop intelligent systems that didn't exist before and to guide others in that journey.

* **Building and orchestrating multi\-agent systems.**
* LLM application stacks (RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, model evaluation).

* Curious, collaborative, and self\-directed, you thrive in environments where ambiguity is an opportunity for groundbreaking work.
* You care about user experience and business outcomes as much as you do about algorithmic elegance.



  





**Why Join Alphix?** 



* **Pioneer a new paradigm:** 
 We are building the next generation of marketing intelligence from first principles, transitioning from a static web app to a dynamic, agentic experience.
* **Lead a team, own your impact:** 
 Your work will define the core of our next\-gen product, drive our product roadmap, and give you the opportunity to lead in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Machine Learning and AI Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a ML and AI Engineer to join our growing Data \& AI team and play a pivotal role in designing and delivering next\-generation Artificial Intelligence solutions, with a strong emphasis on Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, Agentic AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), for our public sector and enterprise clients.
 



 As a ML and AI Engineer, you will collaborate with data architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to create innovative, cloud\-based AI solutions that leverage the latest advancements in GenAI. You’ll be instrumental in helping clients unlock new value from their data, automate complex processes, and drive digital transformation through the practical application of cutting\-edge AI.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity to join a passionate and forward\-thinking team, working on impactful projects across diverse industries. You’ll help shape the future of AI adoption for our clients, delivering solutions that make a real difference.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Fine\-tune, deploy, and monitor Generative AI models and Agentic AI for enterprise use cases.
* Develop and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and advanced context engineering strategies.
* Integrate Agentic AI into business workflows to accelerate solution delivery.
* Collaborate with data engineers to bring Agentic capabilities to production.
* Stay current with AI trends, tools, and best practices, and drive innovation within the team



  





**About you** 



* 3\+ years of experience in ML/AI, with a recent focus on GenAI and LLMs.
* Experience with GenAI frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain, Agentic).
* Proficient in context engineering, RAG, and LLMOps.
* Experience deploying ML/AI solutions on Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry).
* Strong understanding of responsible AI and model safety.
* Have experience in Computer Vision for Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and object recognition



  





**What we look for in our people** 



* Strong alignment with FSP values and ethos
* Commitment to teamwork, quality and mutual success
* Proactivity with an ability to operate with pace and energy
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Dedication to excellence and quality



  





**Who are FSP?** 




 Founded in 2012, FSP Consulting Services (FSP) is a best\-in\-class digital transformation and cyber consultancy specialist combining real world experience in business strategy, change and adoption and digital solution delivery with a strong culture and social purpose.
 



 As a long\-standing Microsoft Solutions Partner, our portfolio of modern workplace, cloud, data, and cyber security offerings, alongside trusted managed services delivery, is driving change for high\-profile clients in both the public and private sector. Our work is founded on the commitment to deliver positive impact for both organisations and their people.
 



 As an employee\-first organisation, FSP is committed to creating a culture of True Belonging, Excellence Everywhere, and Creating Opportunity.
 



 We are proud to have been recognised by Best Companies™ as a 3\-star ‘World Class’ workplace (their highest level of accreditation) in 2024, 2023 and 2022\. We were also awarded No.1 Best Company to Work For in the UK, in the Technology sector and in the South\-East (Regional League Table) in 2023\.
 



 We have also been recognised three times as No.1 Best Workplace™ in the UK by Great Place to Work®.
 



 Find out more about our awards here: https://fsp.co/awards/
 



  





**Why work for FSP?** 




 At FSP, we are committed to providing:
 


* A collaborative and supportive environment in which you can grow and develop your career
* The tools and opportunity to do work you can be proud of
* A chance to work alongside some of the best people in the industry, who always seek to share their knowledge and experience
* Hybrid working – we empower you to make smart choices about when and where to work to achieve great results
* Industry leading coaching and mentoring
* Competitive salary and an excellent benefits package



  





**Equal and Fair Opportunity** 




 FSP is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all suitable candidates. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief.
 



  





 Research suggests that applicants from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for roles if they do not precisely meet requirements, or if they felt there were clear barriers as to who should apply. If you are excited about a potential role with us but are concerned that you may not be a perfect fit, please do apply, as you may be the ideal candidate for this role or for a different vacancy within FSP.
 



 We endeavour to always provide fair opportunity for applicants to showcase themselves in the best way possible during any interviews or meetings. If you require any adjustments for a call or in\-person meeting, please let us know

description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is looking for high performing students to join our world\-class internship experience. Summer 2026 will be better than ever as we bring all interns together on\-site for orientation week and prep students for the future ways of work by offering remote and hybrid opportunities depending on your location. For more information about our Emerging Talent Program, visit https://www.ea.com/careers/interns\-and\-university\-graduates
   

  

 The Infrastructure and Platform Services (IPS) team serves as the backbone of EA's global ecosystem, supporting the creation of exceptional games and immersive player experiences. We offer essential platforms such as Cloud, Commerce, AI, Gameplay Services, Identity, and Social. By delivering reusable capabilities, we enable game teams to seamlessly integrate our services, allowing them to concentrate on crafting some of the world's best games and fostering meaningful connections with players. As the driving force behind the scenes, we ensure everything works in harmony. Join us in shaping the future of play.
   

  

 The Challenge Ahead
   

  

 The AI Platform team delivers centralized AI resources across all Electronic Arts franchises, crafting AI and Generative AI solutions alongside a shared AI infrastructure for company\-wide application. Our team employs a state\-of\-the\-art, cloud\-based tech stack equipped with top\-tier tools to support initiatives such as data modeling, model training and fine\-tuning, and agent development. We provide solutions and platforms that empower the future of game development, marketing, sales, and player experiences.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer with expertise in AI/ML systems and platform development, you will help create a scalable AI Platform.
   

  

 You will report to the Senior Manager of the AI Platform team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop key AI infrastructure components to support end\-to\-end machine learning lifecycle operations.
* Establish scalable, secure, and reliable cloud\-based platforms for large\-scale data analysis, model development, validation, and deployment in real\-time applications.
* Design and implement efficient, automated customer\-facing processes and workflows that leverage AI platform technologies.
* Work with producers, data scientists, ML engineers, and game developers to seamlessly integrate machine learning solutions into live services, ensuring effective model deployment and performance in production environments.
* Design and implement cloud solutions using AWS, GCP, or Azure to support scalable machine learning workloads with high availability.
* Manage and operate commercial tools and platforms such as Databricks, AWS and GCP.
* Optimize the platform and deployed models for performance, security, scalability, and cost efficiency in real\-time, live environments.


**Qualifications**
* Currently enrolled in a Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields focusing on AI/ML systems or platform development.
* Proficiency in Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch
* Proficiency in Python programming
* Experience in CI/CD, containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing and building scalable cloud\-based solutions for machine learning lifecycle.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud\-native tools (e.g. terraform) for managing infrastructure.
* Experience deploying and managing machine learning models in production for real\-time applications.
* Experience with one or more data lakehouse solutions, like Snowflake, Trino, Redshift, or Spark.
* Experience with Gen AI technologies like diffusion models and LLM.


 You must be available for a full\-time paid internship in the summer of 2026\.
   

  

 At this time, we are considering Masters students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the summer of 2026, slated to graduate no earlier than December 2026\. **Principal Consultant / Head of AI**


**About Us**



AlleyCorp Nord is a boutique consultancy building at the intersection of AI and healthcare. We solve challenging human problems by applying cutting\-edge technology and domain understanding.


**About the role**



This is a director\-level position with both external, client\-facing, and internal responsibilities. In this role, you will be the most senior technical leader for our overall AI and data science practice, and set and represent the company's technical vision as pertains to AI. You will spend the majority of your time working with clients, whether as part of a team or independently. You will also spend a significant portion of your time participating in sales cycles and representing the company at events (conferences, etc).


**Your work will consist of:**


* Billable client work (\~50% of the time), which might include:
	+ Serving as technical lead and architect on client project teams, working closely with clients, project managers, product designers, software developers, and generally interdisciplinary teams — in these engagements, you will be expected to be hands\-on.
	+ Solo hands\-on work — e.g. doing advisory research for clients, creating proofs\-of\-concept, occasionally contributing production\-ready code to client and internal projects.
* Working with our sales and business development team to grow the business by leading technical discussions in sales cycles, contributing to marketing materials, and attending events.
* Working with business development and marketing to articulate the company's vision and achievements as pertains to AI and data science; contributing to written materials, participating in events, and otherwise representing the company.
* Mentoring our most senior technical team members and providing guidance to our AI practice guild.
* Leading internal working groups on AI and data science practices and standards to be deployed across our projects; collaborating with other senior data scientists and AI engineers to ensure the quality of project delivery.
* Collaborating with software development and design leadership to identify opportunities for our AI teams to create additional leverage, e.g. via internal projects and new services.

#### **About you**



We are seeking a seasoned technical leader who loves solving business problems with AI. You thrive on understanding the most cutting edge technology — while still being pragmatic about its reasonable applications. This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to have impact across teams and be able to lead projects. This is also, crucially, a very external\-facing role.


**You should have:**


* A proven track record of technical leadership.
* Broad experience in data science and AI, across multiple different subfields (e.g. from NLP to computer vision).
* A strong sense of the economics and business value of AI solutions.
* An academic background in AI or a related field.
* 8\+ years overall experience as a technology professional, ideally across different types of roles (e.g. research, applied research, product).
* Must have exceptional leadership and communication skills.
* Must have strong French language presentation, technical and interpersonal skills and the ability to work comfortably with American clients.


We would love for you to have some exposure to healthcare (clinical operations, medical devices, pharma, etc.), since that is our primary area of focus, but it's a nice to have.



We typically hire generalists. In this role, we are expecting you to be primarily an AI and data science specialist but have a strong interest in helping generalists learn about AI and an affinity for adjacent domains — namely design and engineering.



All of job postings describe a bit of a unicorn. If you're kind of a "narwhal," please apply anyway. You don't need to meet all the requirements, let alone the bonus criteria. While experience and skill sets are valuable, growth potential and attitudes are equally important. We are usually flexible on levels or can advise you when a more relevant posting opens.


**What we offer**



We are a remote\-first company with office space in Montreal. We prefer to hire in Quebec, but we are open to candidates anywhere in the EST±2 time zone in Canada.



Some of our benefits — ask us for more details during the interview process!


* Home office/technology budget;
* Yearly professional development budget;
* Parental leave top\-up (8 weeks), regardless of path to parenthood;
* Annual compensation review, benchmarking to industry and inflation changes. Annual and project\-based performance reviews.
* From Day 1 — 100% employer\-paid health \& dental insurance including a yearly bank of coverage for complementary medicine (Acupuncture, osteopathy, massage therapy, naturopathy, psychology, etc.); Life, long \& short\-term disability insurance.
* After 1 year — company RRSP matching and profit\-sharing participation.


AlleyCorp Nord values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity, for us, means fostering a workplace in which a person's differences are recognized, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize their talents and strengths.

 focusing on customer problems
* Expert in

 ).
* Hands\-on experience with
 **LLMs**

 **search/relevance systems** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **vector databases**

 **experiment design \& evaluation** 
 ; able to communicate trade\-offs to technical and exec stakeholders.

* **First\-principles problem solver** 
 who thrives in ambiguity.
* **Product\-oriented builder** 
 — you care as much about solving customer pain as about model elegance.
* **Rapid experimenter** 
 — comfortable with scrappy prototypes and fast iteration.

 comfortable using tools like Cursor, Bolt, Lovable and Vercel \+ V0 for rapid iteration.

 — excited to stay ahead of the curve in a fast\-moving AI field.

* **Green\-field impact**

 At Air New Zealand, we’re reimagining the future of travel by embedding AI at the heart of how we serve our customers and empower our people. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to contribute to the design and delivery of AI applications that unlock new possibilities across the business.

You will collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and software engineers to turn cutting\-edge models and proof\-of\-concepts into robust, production\-ready systems that integrate seamlessly with our digital platforms.

You’ll help drive the engineering of reliable, secure, and high\-performing AI services, while mentoring others and influencing Air New Zealand’s AI strategy. Your work will directly support innovations such as personalised digital experiences, smarter operations, and AI\-assisted employee tools that make travel simpler, smarter, and more sustainable.

 As a Senior AI Engineer, you will:
 


* Design, build, and maintain Generative AI services and applications in Python, from proof\-of\-concept to production.

* Implement safeguards, guardrails, monitoring, and governance for responsible AI usage.
* Collaborate with business teams to identify opportunities where Generative AI can deliver value.
* Stay ahead of emerging GenAI technologies and bring innovative approaches into practice



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




 You’re a Senior Engineer who solves real\-world problems with AI and data, and has experience developing and deploying safe, scalable GenAI applications from proof\-of\-concept to production. You’re equally comfortable architecting agentic systems, writing clean production code, and guiding others to deliver high\-quality AI\-centric solutions.
 


* Proven expertise in Generative AI: LLMs, agents, embeddings/rerankers, vector databases, and prompt design/evaluation.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals including at least 3 years developing in Python, including experience with asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI), testing \& mocking, and CI/CD.
* Strong data engineering \& MLOps fundamentals including designing and querying relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases, feature stores, model/registry versioning, offline/online evaluation, and golden datasets.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS \- preferred, Azure, or GCP) and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation) advantageous.
* Security, privacy, and compliance in enterprise settings; comfort working with sensitive data and regulated environments.
* A growth mindset: curiosity, experimentation, and the drive to turn ideas into robust, maintainable systems.



  





**What You’ll Get in Return** 



* A chance to work on industry\-leading, high\-impact platforms that support Air New Zealand’s digital products.
* A respectful, diverse, and inclusive team culture where you’ll be supported and valued.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning and career development opportunities.
* Competitive salary and unique staff travel benefits to help you explore the world.

About Programmers Force
  
Programmers Force is a leading B2B SaaS development powerhouse, specializing in cutting\-edge RegTech, FinTech, and AI\-driven compliance solutions. As a strategic technology partner to global enterprises, we power businesses with scalable, regulation\-compliant SaaS products.
  
We are looking for a SaaS RegTech Analyst \& Whitepaper Writer who will create highly technical, research\-driven content to position our products as market leaders. This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, technology research, and thought leadership, crafting whitepapers, industry reports, and in\-depth technical content for C\-level executives, compliance teams, and SaaS buyers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As a SaaS RegTech Analyst \& Whitepaper Writer, you will research and develop data\-driven, strategic content that educates the market, establishes industry authority, and drives product adoption. You will create deep\-dive whitepapers, market trend reports, technical case studies, and competitive analysis insights, blending technical expertise with compelling storytelling.
  
This role is ideal for a product marketing professional with a research\-driven mindset and an interest in RegTech, AML/KYC compliance, AI\-driven risk management, and digital identity verification.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Technology \& Industry Research (SaaS \& RegTech Focus)
  
* Conduct in\-depth market research on the RegTech, AI\-driven compliance, and identity verification industries.
* Analyze trends in AML, KYC, fraud prevention, data privacy regulations (GDPR, PSD2, FATF, OFAC, etc.), and produce thought leadership reports.
* Benchmark Programmers Force's SaaS solutions against competitors like Jumio, Onfido, Trulioo, ComplyAdvantage, and Sumsub.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and compliance teams to develop technical deep\-dives on how our SaaS solutions solve industry challenges.


Whitepaper \& Technical Content Development
  
* Develop highly technical whitepapers explaining complex SaaS architectures, AI algorithms, and compliance automation in a digestible format.
* Write research\-backed industry reports, buyer’s guides, and analyst briefs tailored for CISOs, CTOs, compliance officers, and regulators.
* Produce case studies showcasing how our SaaS solutions solve real\-world compliance challenges.
* Work with data teams to integrate original insights, survey results, and statistical findings into content.


Product Marketing \& Strategic Positioning
  
* Translate technical capabilities into business value propositions that resonate with B2B decision\-makers.
* Align whitepapers, reports, and case studies with sales enablement, go\-to\-market strategies, and demand generation.
* Create messaging frameworks that position our AML/KYC solutions as industry\-leading.
* Assist in thought leadership initiatives by ghostwriting articles, reports, and insights for executive stakeholders.


Competitive \& Regulatory Analysis
  
* Track regulatory changes and compliance challenges impacting financial institutions, fintechs, and digital businesses.
* Conduct competitive intelligence to highlight our unique selling propositions (USPs) in the identity verification and AML space.
* Develop data\-backed comparisons between our SaaS offerings and key market competitors.


**Requirements:**  

Qualifications \& Skills
  
  

**Must\-Have:**  

* 5\+ years experience in product marketing, SaaS research, technical content writing, or market analysis.
* Expertise in RegTech, AML, KYC, fraud prevention, or compliance automation (or strong ability to learn).
* Experience writing highly technical whitepapers, industry reports, or SaaS product briefs.
* Ability to translate AI\-driven SaaS solutions and compliance frameworks into clear, engaging content for different audiences.
* Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS sales cycles, go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies, and compliance\-driven purchasing decisions.
* Hands\-on experience conducting competitive research and product positioning.


**Nice\-to\-Have:**  

* Experience working with B2B SaaS providers in FinTech, RegTech, or Identity Verification.
* Familiarity with AML regulations (FATF, OFAC, GDPR, PSD2, MAS, etc.).
* Ability to work with data teams to create research\-driven content with insights, charts, and industry statistics.
* Experience in executive ghostwriting, analyst briefings, or industry event content creation.


**Benefits:**  

* Be part of a fast\-growing global SaaS company developing next\-generation AI\-driven solutions.
* Play a pivotal role in shaping the sales enablement and training strategy for a high\-impact B2B product.
* Work alongside industry leaders, compliance experts, and AI engineers driving innovation in the RegTech space.
* Competitive salary, benefits, and growth opportunities in a leadership\-driven culture.

Generative AI Engineer \- Pre\-IPO Tech Company
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a talented
 **Generative AI Engineer** 
 to help design and build the next generation of AI\-powered applications at a high\-growth, pre\-IPO technology company. You will work on applying large language models (LLMs), multimodal AI, and cutting\-edge generative techniques to create products that transform how our customers interact with data, content, and decision\-making systems.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of AI research and scalable product development. You will collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product managers to prototype, deploy, and optimize generative AI systems that deliver measurable customer and business impact.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Develop Generative Applications: Build production\-ready systems leveraging LLMs and generative models for NLP, code, and multimodal use cases.
* Integrate with Products: Design APIs and services that embed generative AI capabilities into customer\-facing applications.
* Optimize Models: Fine\-tune, distill, and adapt foundation models to specific tasks and domains for efficiency and performance.
* Leverage Retrieval \& Memory: Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and embeddings for context\-aware AI solutions.
* Ensure Reliability: Build monitoring and evaluation pipelines to track model quality, detect drift, and maintain trustworthiness in production.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work with researchers and product leaders to translate cutting\-edge AI into practical features.
* Stay Ahead: Keep current with state\-of\-the\-art generative AI research and frameworks, bringing new ideas and approaches into the company.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Professional Experience: 3\-7 years in applied ML/AI engineering, with at least 1\-2 years working on generative AI, LLMs, or related areas.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python, strong experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* LLM Experience: Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning or deploying large language models, and familiarity with APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar.
* Infrastructure Knowledge: Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS Sagemaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS).
* Systems Thinking: Ability to design scalable pipelines for training, inference, and integration into production systems.
* Collaboration: Strong communication skills and ability to partner across engineering, product, and research teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field; PhD a plus.


 Why Join
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of generative AI at a pre\-IPO company with $500M\+ in funding. As a Generative AI Engineer, you’ll work with state\-of\-the\-art models, solve complex problems at scale, and bring transformative AI capabilities directly to customers. You’ll be part of a high\-growth team where innovation is encouraged, impact is immediate, and the future of AI is being built.
   

  

**About Andiamo**
 Andiamo is a globally recognized staffing and consulting firm specializing in placing the top 2% of technology and go\-to\-market professionals with the world’s largest and most well\-known companies.
   

  

 For over 20 years, we've maintained the status of tier\-one vendor for firms such as Amazon, Bloomberg, Palantir, MasterCard, Visa, Two Sigma, Citadel, as well as other major financial services firms, elite hedge funds, Google\-backed tech start\-ups, and major software firms.
   

  

 Our talent solutions include Permanent Placement, Contract Staffing, Executive Search, and Dedicated Recruiting Services (RPO). Find out more at www.andiamogo.com

description:
Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.
 



  





***We are unable to consider sponsorship for authorization to work, for this role. All applicants must be US citizens, or current green card holders.***




  





 We are currently seeking a talented and driven
 **Senior AI Engineer** 
 to join our Advanced Intelligence Group (AIG). The AIG will focus on exploring ways to utilize AI within Lummus Technology to empower our business units and fundamentally transform how our company operates. This position will work directly with our world\-class experts in process engineering, design, and project management to solve their toughest challenges. Our goal is to augment our people, freeing them from repetitive work so they can focus on the high\-value, creative problem\-solving that has made Lummus a global leader. If you're driven to see your work come to life in tangible, industrial\-scale applications and to weave your own thread of innovation into our company's future, we want to talk to you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner directly with business and engineering leaders to understand their core challenges and translate those needs into technical specifications for AI solutions.
* Design, build, train, and deploy a wide range of machine learning and generative AI models to solve complex problems.
* Develop and manage the data pipelines required for our AI systems, ensuring data quality and readiness for model training and inference.
* Integrate AI models into existing Lummus business applications and workflows using APIs and other services to create seamless user experiences.
* Fine\-tune and evaluate large language models (LLMs) and vision models on our proprietary data, with a focus on performance, accuracy, and IP security.
* Own the full lifecycle of AI applications, from initial prototyping and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Foster innovation by researching new techniques and technologies to stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI landscape.



  





**Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or other engineering discipline, Mathematics, Data Science, or a relevant field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in computer or software engineering.
* Proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (Pandas, NumPy, others).
* Strong experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Strong experience building modern GenAI stacks.



  





**Additional Qualifications:** 



* Experience in processing engineering, chemical, or related industries.
* **Experience with advanced agentic concepts like multi\-agent systems or complex planning techniques.**
* **Expertise with our key partner platforms, including Microsoft Azure, Databricks, or Google Cloud (Vertex AI).**
* **Experience with big data technologies (like Spark) and a strong understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases.**
* Ability to drive change management around AI.
* Ability to communicate well about complex topics.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
